title: Interpretable Acoustic Features from Wakefulness Tracheal Breathing for OSA Severity Assessment.
summary: Learned acoustic features from tracheal breathing are evaluated for OSA severity. Results compares model-derived severity with sleep-study reference; diagnostic association limited to examined cohort.
